design.generationBoundary: A prose provider receives only document id, kind, title and generic brief. It receives no cases, splits, groups, anchor text, marker positions or distractor metadata. A deterministic local assembler inserts the separately declared anchor text at its marker and removes marker tokens from final canonical text.
design.temporalCoverage: All declared groups run at the final reporting cutoff. The corpus exercises current-version changes during the second and third weeks and retains prior decision requests; it does not measure independent earlier-cutoff retrieval quality.
design.groupDeclaration: Each split has disjoint triples covering all cases and fixed overlapping quintets covering all cases. Groups were declared before generation or evaluation.
design.expectedMarkerBehavior: Each version is assembled independently. Every declared marker occurs exactly once before replacement and zero times in final text. Record exact canonical UTF-16 offsets after replacement; do not search by evaluator labels during retrieval.

anchors.text: The September gate remains closed because duplicate consignments appeared in the rehearsal.

The dispatch rehearsal repeated on September eighteenth completed with zero duplicate consignments across forty thousand labels. The release owner cleared the regional rollout after reconciling every label against the booking ledger.

The repaired webhook retry logic passed a sustained replay with zero duplicate deliveries and the production observation window closed without recurrence. The incident owner approved closure while preserving the replay check in regression coverage.

documents.title: Emissions accounting review

The approved service inventory includes warehouse energy and carrier fuel and shows an eight percent reduction per completed shipment on a like-for-like route mix. Sustainability approved only the eight percent service claim and rejected the electricity-only headline.

documents.title: Demand planning review

anchors.text: The draft sales forecast treats verbal pipeline interest as contracted shipment demand.

The revised forecast separates signed bookings from verbal pipeline and identifies only sixty percent of planned demand as committed. Finance rejected a firm capacity purchase sized to the full forecast and permitted an option on the uncommitted portion.
